summary: Kimai is a Symfony/PHP self-hosted time-tracking application that persists its core domain (timesheets, customers, projects, activities, users, teams, invoices, tags, working-time contract records, bookmarks, export templates, config and API access tokens) in a Doctrine/MySQL schema and exposes full CRUD over a REST API plus HTML admin controllers.
